rationale: Bookkeeping that reflects the actual state of the four questions after the retained evidence landed. The child premise question is answered by its control receipt: the held-proposal effect requires the member to be dropped from both halves, and a member kept as an outgoing voter proposes and commits normally. The recovery question is answered by its own receipt: a member restarted from persisted state recovered the entry committed while it was down, relearned the leader and proposed successfully, with the single-restart, no-snapshot scope stated. The exploration question stays open because the one combination it has not sampled, restarts of members inside the randomized run, is still worth one execution, so it is deliberately not marked explained.
